messages.subject: processData at FeatureLevelData
parts:
Greetings,

I am currently performing peptidomics to analysis differentially expression of non-tryptic peptides. I have the MSstats file from FragPipe and would like to process the MSstats.csv file at peptide level.

By any chance would you be able to advise me on how to engage the processData at peptide level and subsequently use the processData with data ProcessPlots?

Laslty, in another context, would you be able to advise me if the future updated version of MSstats would include a guide on how to process FragPipe MSstats.csv file?

Regards,
Parthiban

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: processData at FeatureLevelData
parts:
Hi Parthiban,

The MSstats.csv file is actually already converted by FragPipe for use in MSstats. You can use it as is using the code below.

```
msstats_input = read.csv("msstats.csv")
summarized_data = MSstats::dataProcess(msstats_input)
```

For peptide level analysis you just need to replace the protein name column with the peptide column.

```
msstats_input = read.csv("msstats.csv")
msstats_input$ProteinName = msstats_input$PeptideSequence
summarized_data = MSstats::dataProcess(msstats_input)
```

Fyi we will be adding a FragPipe converter shortly and it will provide additional filtering steps and include a tutorial on how to use data from FragPipe. However this is not strictly necessary as FragPipe already outputs the data in the required format.

Devon
